blocks.text: Period mein baen se daen jate hue electronegativity barhti hai, kyunke nuclear charge barhta aur jasamat ghat'ti hai. Group mein yeh oopar se neeche ghat'ti hai, kyunke shells jurne se jasamat barhti aur shielding effect barhta hai. Maslan halogen group mein qeemat fluorine (4.0) se iodine (2.5) tak girti hai. Metals, table ki baen taraf, non-metals se kam electronegativity qeematein rakhte hain, to metals nisbatan electropositive aur non-metals electronegative hain.

blocks.alt: Periodic table ka hissa, Pauling electronegativity qeematon ke saath: oopar ke teer par H 2.1; Li 1.0, Be 1.5, B 2.0, C 2.5, N 3.0, O 3.5, F 4.0; Na 0.9, Mg 1.2, Al 1.5, Si 1.8, P 2.1, S 2.5, Cl 3.0; K 0.8, Ca 1.0, Br 2.8; Rb 0.8, Sr 1.0, I 2.5. Oopar ka teer daen taraf aur daen taraf ka teer oopar, dono par 'Electronegativity increases' likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer us simt mein hai jidhar woh khasiyat barhti hai. Ionization energy aur electron affinity period mein baen se daen aur group mein neeche se oopar barhti hain, is liye yeh dono oopar aur daen taraf hain. Atomic radius ulta chalta hai: group mein neeche aur period mein daen se baen barhta hai. Tirchhe teer batate hain ke non-metallic kirdar oopar daen kone (F ki taraf) aur metallic kirdar neeche baen kone (Cs, Fr ki taraf) barhta hai. Kitab mein 'Electon affinity' chhapa hai aur khaane ka jaal 19 columns ka hai, period 7 adhoora; yahan durust 'Electron affinity' aur 18 groups, 7 periods ka jaal banaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Chhapi qeematon se batayein ke kaun sa bond zyada polar hai, H se Cl ya H se Br, aur period 3 ka kaun sa unsur sab se electropositive hai.
blocks.explanation: H se Cl zyada polar hai: chlorine (3.0) aur hydrogen (2.1) ka farq 0.9 hai, bromine (2.8) ke liye 0.7. Sodium (0.9) period 3 mein sab se kam qeemat rakhta hai aur us ka sab se electropositive unsur hai.

items: Electronegativity period mein barhti (zyada nuclear charge, chhota atom) aur group mein neeche ghat'ti hai (zyada shells, zyada shielding): F 4.0 se I 2.5.
Baen ke metals electropositive, daen ke non-metals electronegative.
